items.raw_excerpt: Desde la capital cordobesa se llega por la RP 16, después de subir por la RN 9. Tiene calles tranquilas y una opción interesante en hotelería.
items.summary_en: Villa Tulumba is a small colonial town in Córdoba, Argentina. It was selected as one of the most beautiful towns in the world. The town has quiet streets and interesting places to stay.

items.raw_excerpt: Goa is changing its tourism narrative with goa beyond beaches initiative—promoting sustainability, community empowerment, and meaningful travel experiences.

items.raw_excerpt: Unique candidat pour un 6° mandat à la tête de Jonage, le maire de Jonage Lucien Barge (LR) aborde avec sérénité le scrutin de ce dimanche ...
items.summary_en: Lucien Barge, the longtime mayor of Jonage near Lyon, is running for a sixth term in the 2026 municipal elections. He promises to expand the small town center if re-elected. Jonage is a commune in the Metropole of Lyon in eastern France.

items.raw_excerpt: Hepburn Springs has largely resisted the compromises of the 21st century, preserving its village character while ensuring it remains one of regional Victoria's most enduring tourism destinations.
items.summary_en: Hepburn Springs has kept its old village character through the years. It remains one of regional Victoria's most popular tourism places. Visitors come to enjoy the spa town's charm.
